raw_criterion: |a-b|/max(1,|a|,|b|)<=1e-10 for each real/imaginary coefficient component; original failures retained unchanged
dimensional_diagnostic: |a-b|/max(Q^(N-rank),|a|,|b|), Q=max absolute real component among all dimension-one masses and external momenta, dimension-one imaginary components required zero. Every coefficient homogeneity established exactly with Symbolica. This diagnostic does not replace the raw criterion or constitute physical end-to-end acceptance.
high_precision_scope: DD and Float128 compare to256-bit exact-represented-input baseline. Float256 candidate comparisons test same-precision consistency; near-zero256-bit references may have few tracked bits, with selected exact substitution additionally recorded.
corpus_scope: Four canonical physical graphs/kinematic points, coupling controls and original batch sizes; no general conditioning/overflow coverage
